div.div: - POST /runs with pasted SRS text or one file (up to 4 MB) through the throttled HTTP API.
- API Lambda enforces per-IP (6/hour, hashed IP) and daily (40) caps, stores the SRS in S3.

- sets CORS, writes ui/config.js and uploads the UI to Amplify, then smoke-tests the runtime.

div.i: Agent runtime role: ECR pull, logs, X-Ray, metrics and Bedrock InvokeModel only.
No S3 or DynamoDB access: the agent is stateless.
S3 private, TLS-only, SSE; DynamoDB PITR + SSE + TTL. Both retained on stack delete.
Open API: add a JWT authorizer (Entra ID) before using confidential SRS.
